title: GTA 6 Age Ratings Reveal Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes
description: Official age ratings for GTA 6 have been published for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, revealing content descriptions that include drug use, nudity, and sexual fetishes.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Age Ratings Revealed, Highlighting Mature Content Descriptions

The release of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated open-world epic is truly drawing near. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, the official age ratings for the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of GTA 6 have now been officially published as the November 19, 2026 release date approaches.

### Familiar Mature Rating for the Franchise

Unsurprisingly, the title has been rated M for Mature in the USA and 18+ in the UK. This comes as no shock to longtime fans of the franchise, which has historically pushed boundaries with its mature themes, satirical take on modern society, and unfiltered criminal sandbox gameplay. However, it is not the rating letter itself that has caught the attention of the gaming community, but rather the content descriptions tied directly to these age ratings.

### Deeper Insights into the Game's Content

According to the published rating details, the content descriptions share explicit elements that will be present in the game. These include references to drug use, nudity, and sexual fetishes. Such descriptions suggest that Rockstar Games is continuing to lean heavily into realistic and mature portrayals of modern culture, maintaining the edgy tone that the series is famous for worldwide.

While we await further official deep dives from Rockstar Games, the publication of these age ratings serves as a concrete milestone confirming that the game is firmly on track for its scheduled release.

## Editor's Take

The revelation of these age rating descriptions offers a fascinating, albeit unsurprising, glimpse into the mature themes of GTA 6. It reassures fans that Rockstar is not shying away from the edgy, unfiltered satire that defines the series. As we count down the days to launch, these small updates keep the momentum building toward what is undoubtedly the biggest gaming event of the decade.
